name: RBAC & Multi-Tenant Isolation
description: Verify role-based access control per page and multi-tenant data isolation. Login as each of 5 orgs × key roles, verify no cross-org data leakage. Verify settings tile visibility per role. Verify management page RBAC redirect.
acceptanceCriteria: T-015.AC1: Serra Honda admin sees ONLY Serra Honda data on all pages
T-015.AC2: Serra Nissan admin sees ONLY Serra Nissan data on all pages
T-015.AC3: Tony Serra Ford admin sees ONLY Tony Serra Ford data on all pages
T-015.AC4: Ford of Columbia admin sees ONLY Ford of Columbia data on all pages
T-015.AC5: Hyundai of Columbia admin sees ONLY Hyundai of Columbia data on all pages
T-015.AC6: Partner admin (Cage) sees all 5 dealership data in management
T-015.AC7: Partner admin does NOT see Huminic data
T-015.AC8: Settings tiles: super_admin sees 7, partner_admin sees 7 (AI Config read-only), org_admin sees 6
T-015.AC9: Management page redirects non-management roles to home
method: Playwright MCP — multi-login cycles against dev.huminicdev.com
